text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The summer training camp to hone their 
skills begins once again this year. 
Orfevre, now the center of attention, was 
drawing even more eyes than before her 
Triple Crown challenge.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Wah, Orfevre-san... She has such an 
incredible presence...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
They say they're shutting out the press 
right from the start this year because 
there'd be too much of a rush.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
...It really feels like they could win it, 
the Arc de Triomphe. Japan might 
finally...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: —Orfe-san.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"It appears the delivery of equipment for 
the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe training is 
complete. Would you like to inspect it?"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Or. It seems the URA staff have prepared a 
special training program for you. What 
would you like to do?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...I leave everything to the one over 
there.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Heeeey, whoa there, your face is 
completely green, dude.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Take it from me, someone who's super 
satsuki—you're definitely... an alien from 
the Matcha Planet. Pure matchatcha.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I don't quite get it, but if she's the 
one pointing it out... it must be 
intensely matcha.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Lately, I've been having the same 
recurring dream. It's a dream where 
Orfevre loses the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Japan's dream has vanished right before 
the finish line...! Orfevre finishes in 
2nd place!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her figure cannot be seen. And yet... that 
shadow surging past just before the wire 
is unmistakably Orfevre. And then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I wondered if I was becoming neurotic from 
the pressure... but with each passing day, 
the feeling that it was real only grew 
stronger.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: —...Wha? Whaaaaattt????

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: TEAAA!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, an intense smell of the ocean 
assaulted my nose. Before I knew it, Gold 
Ship... was holding a baseball glove.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Oh, you're back. How was your hometown?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Don't just stand there dazed. Summer's 
already... begun, you know.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—I must analyze this. Why am I having this 
dream? Is it psychogenic, or... If 
necessary, I must take countermeasures.
choice_data_list: (All for the sake of Orfevre's victory!)

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...The offerings gathered for me are all 
assembled. Yet merely gazing upon them 
renders them useless junk.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"What makes it useful is your mind. Hurry 
along and finish your preparations."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of the King's flawless 
victory.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It looks like this will be an 
unforgettable summer—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: —Are you sure about this, Orfe?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Anyone can see... you're 
completely exhausted.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
She must have her own reasons. The King 
does not move.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...I need only wait upon my throne.
